en.headline: Centre for Health Protection records three new community Legionnaires’ disease cases
en.dek: The cases involved three men aged 44 to 67 living in Tai Po and Kwai Tsing; they are considered sporadic with no links to earlier cases, bringing the year’s total to 160.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said it recorded three community-acquired cases of Legionnaires’ disease between 11 and 17 October.

The cases involved three men aged between 44 and 67 who live in Tai Po and Kwai Tsing. One of the men is a smoker and the other two have underlying illnesses. Preliminary investigations show the cases are sporadic and have no epidemiological links to other confirmed cases previously recorded in Hong Kong.

The centre is conducting epidemiological investigations to identify possible sources of infection and high-risk exposure factors. As of 17 October, a total of 160 Legionnaires’ disease cases had been recorded this year. In 2025 and 2024, there were 167 and 135 cases respectively.

Men, people aged over 50, smokers, alcoholics and persons with weakened immunity are more susceptible. The centre reminded the public of the importance of properly maintaining man-made water systems, as Legionella bacteria can grow in warm water between 20 and 45 degrees Celsius.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心錄得三宗社區感染退伍軍人病個案
zh.dek: 個案涉及三名44至67歲男子，居於大埔及葵青，屬散發個案，與早前個案無流行病學關連，今年累計160宗。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心表示，十月十一日至十七日期間錄得三宗社區感染退伍軍人病個案。
個案涉及三名年齡介乎44至67歲的男子，分別居於大埔和葵青。其中一人有吸煙習慣，另外兩人有長期病患。初步調查顯示屬散發個案，沒有資料顯示與本港早前錄得的其他確診個案有流行病學關連。
中心正展開流行病學調查，以找出可能的感染源頭和高風險接觸因素。截至十月十七日，今年錄得160宗退伍軍人病個案。二〇二五年及二〇二四年分別錄得167及135宗。
男士、50歲以上人士、吸煙人士、酗酒人士和免疫力弱的人士較易感染。中心提醒市民妥善保養人造供水系統，退伍軍人桿菌適合在攝氏20至45度的溫水中生長。
